title: statusLine customization: full stdin contract, render slot, colouring, truncation, and refresh cadence for F7
repro: write {"statusLine":{"type":"command","command":"<abs path>","padding":0}} into the ISOLATED HOME's .claude/settings.json
point it at a script that saves stdin and prints one line
launch claude, run a turn, count invocations
claude: WORKS. Render slot: the script's first stdout line is printed on its OWN row, indented 2 spaces, directly ABOVE the footer row and BELOW the composer's bottom rule. Colour: claude paints unstyled script output entirely in SGR 38;5;246 (grey) — the same grey as the footer. Truncation: hard-truncated to pane width with a trailing '…' (no wrap). Footer interaction: while a statusLine is present the footer's '? for shortcuts' segment is dropped ('⏸ manual mode on · ← for agents'). Refresh cadence: NOT on a timer — 30s of pure idle produced zero re-invocations (counter frozen at #2). It fires on (a) startup x2, (b) every Ctrl-C, (c) turn start and turn end, (d) repeatedly while streaming (count went 9 -> 15 across one ~40s turn). STDIN CONTRACT (full, saved to frames-qa6/cc-statusline-stdin.json): session_id, transcript_path, cwd, prompt_id (post-turn only), effort{level}, session_name (post-turn only), model{id,display_name}, workspace{current_dir,project_dir,added_dirs[]}, version, output_style{name}, cost{total_cost_usd,total_duration_ms,total_api_duration_ms,total_lines_added,total_lines_removed}, context_window{total_input_tokens,total_output_tokens,context_window_size,current_usage{input_tokens,output_tokens,cache_creation_input_tokens,cache_read_input_tokens},used_percentage,remaining_percentage}, exceeds_200k_tokens, fast_mode, thinking{enabled}, rate_limits{five_hour{used_percentage,resets_at},seven_day{used_percentage,resets_at}} (post-turn only). Pre-first-turn, context_window.current_usage / used_percentage / remaining_percentage are null and cost is all zeros.
ccx: Not implemented. ccx honours no statusLine setting and has no user-extensible chrome slot; its status bar is a fixed field list (model / mode / think / ctx% / usage warning / streaming / bg count) hard-coded in ChatStatusBar.tsx.

repro: launch each with HTTPS_PROXY=http://127.0.0.1:9 HTTP_PROXY=http://127.0.0.1:9 in a THROWAWAY isolated HOME
submit 'Reply with exactly: NETTEST'
watch for 70s
claude: Within ~4s the spinner row is replaced by '✻ Unable to connect to API (ConnectionRefused) · Retrying in 24s · attempt 8/10'. Colour: the ✻ glyph and the message text are SGR 38;5;211 (pink) on default background [49m; the ' · Retrying in Ns · attempt K/10' tail is 38;5;246 grey. The seconds count DOWN live and the attempt counter climbs 4/10 -> 8/10 with growing backoff (5s,10s,14s,35s...). Footer simultaneously becomes '⏸ manual mode on · esc to interrupt · ← for agents'. Frames: frames-qa6/cc-netfail.txt, cc-netfail.sgr. Related copy seen from a REAL transient failure on the good-network session: '✻ Waiting for API response · will retry in 2m 40s · check your network', and on give-up '⏺ API Error: Connection closed mid-response. No error line, no retry counter, no attempt count, no colour change — visually identical to a healthy long turn. Frames: frames-qa6/ccx-netfail.txt, ccx-netfail.sgr

title: Spinner anatomy: claude's parenthetical carries elapsed + output-token count + a phase word, and its gerund rotates mid-turn; ccx's carries elapsed only and its gerund is fixed for the whole turn
repro: submit a long generation to each
poll capture-pane -p every 0.4s and uniq the spinner row
claude: Format '<glyph> <Gerund>… (<elapsed> · ↓ <n> tokens · <phase>)'. The parenthetical materialises progressively: '✶ Baking…' -> '✽ Baking…' -> '· Baking… (1s · thinking)' -> '✳ Baking… (2s · ↓ 84 tokens · thinking)'. Phase word observed: 'thinking'. Without a statusLine the footer additionally carries 'esc to interrupt' as its middle segment. Gerund ROTATES within a single turn (captured 'Ruminating…' then 'Kneading…' ~3.5s later in one turn). Gerund vocabulary observed across turns: Kneading, Ruminating, Baking. Glyph cycle: · ✢ ✻ ✳ ✶ ✽ (Braille-free asterisk family). Completion line replaces the spinner: '✻ <Past-tense verb> for <elapsed>' in SGR 38;5;246 grey — observed 'Worked for 4s', 'Cooked for 11s', 'Baked for 2s', 'Crunched for 1m 16s'.
ccx: Format '<glyph> <Gerund>… (<elapsed> · esc to interrupt)'. No token counter, no phase word. Gerund does NOT rotate — 'Honking…' held for a full 14s turn and 'Nebulizing…' held past 1m 12s. Same glyph cycle (· ✢ ✻ ✳ ✶ ✽). On completion ccx prints NO 'worked for' line at all; the spinner row simply disappears and 'ctx N%' appears in the status bar. Vocabulary observed: Honking, Nebulizing, Crafting.

title: Exit-arm hint: identical copy, but claude flashes it for ~250-500ms and ccx holds it ~2-6s; and the first Ctrl-C on a NON-empty composer behaves oppositely
repro: type a draft, press Ctrl-C once, poll capture-pane -p every 0.25s
then Ctrl-U to clear, press Ctrl-C on the empty composer, poll again
claude: Copy is exactly 'Press Ctrl-C again to exit'. It replaces BOTH the statusLine row and the footer row for a single sampling tick (~250-500ms at a 0.25s poll: absent at t=0.25s, present at t=0.50s, gone at t=0.75s) then the statusLine+footer come back. With a NON-empty composer, the first Ctrl-C CLEARS the draft (composer reverts to the ghost-text suggestion) and re-invokes the statusLine.
ccx: Same copy, 'Press Ctrl-C again to exit', but rendered as an ADDITIONAL fourth hint row inserted between 'Esc rewind · ? help' and the status bar, and it stays visible for seconds (still present at +1.2s, gone by +6s). With a NON-empty composer the first Ctrl-C does NOT clear the draft — the draft is kept and the exit hint is armed instead. ccx also shows a transient 'Ctrl+Y to paste deleted text' hint after Ctrl-U, which claude does not.

title: Mode chip: ccx prints machine-name modes with no glyph and cycles in a different order than claude
repro: press BTab four times on each, capturing the footer/status row after each press
claude: Ladder and copy (each press): '⏵⏵ accept edits on (shift+tab to cycle) · ← for agents' -> '⏸ plan mode on (shift+tab to cycle) · ← for agents' -> '⏵⏵ auto mode on (shift+tab to cycle) · ← for agents' -> '⏸ manual mode on · ← for agents'. So the order is manual -> accept edits -> plan -> auto -> manual. Each mode carries a leading glyph: ⏸ for the two gated modes (manual, plan), ⏵⏵ for the two ungated ones (accept edits, auto). The '(shift+tab to cycle)' parenthetical is printed for every mode EXCEPT the home state 'manual'. Prose lowercase, always suffixed 'on'.
ccx: Ladder and copy: 'mode default' -> 'mode acceptEdits (⇧Tab to cycle)' -> 'mode plan (⇧Tab to cycle)' -> 'mode auto (⇧Tab to cycle)'. So the order is auto -> default -> acceptEdits -> plan -> auto: a different cycle order AND a different home-state name ('default' vs 'manual'). ccx prints the raw camelCase enum value ('acceptEdits'), never prints a ⏸/⏵⏵ glyph, spells the key as '⇧Tab' rather than 'shift+tab', and omits the trailing 'on'. The suppress-on-home-state rule DOES match (no parenthetical on 'default').
suspects: harness/src/tui/ChatStatusBar.tsx:34-40 (showCycle / mode label), mode cycle order in harness/src/tui/useChat.ts cycleMode

repro: node harness/dist/cli/bin.js --version
node harness/dist/cli/bin.js --help
node harness/dist/cli/bin.js help
claude: `claude --version` -> '2.1.222 (Claude Code)'. `claude --help` -> 234 lines: usage line, one-line description, an Arguments block, ~70 Options with wrapped descriptions, and a Commands block (agents, auth, auto-mode, doctor, gateway, import, install, mcp, plugin|plugins, project, setup-token, ultrareview, update|upgrade). `claude doctor` prints a structured health report — install method, version, commit, platform, install path, search backend, auto-update state and channel, last update attempt, a Remote Control section, then a coloured '4 warnings found' block (SGR 33 yellow) where each warning is a '- <problem>' line followed by an indented '  Fix: <command>' line; exit code 0 even with warnings. title: Context percentage: claude exposes it only through statusLine/slash commands, ccx shows it inline and gates a compaction warning on it
repro: run one turn on each, read the status/footer rows
claude: The default footer NEVER shows a context percentage. The number exists only in the statusLine stdin payload as context_window.used_percentage (4 after one turn, against context_window_size 1000000) and in rate_limits.five_hour/seven_day used_percentage — a custom statusLine script is the only way to put it on screen. exceeds_200k_tokens is a separate boolean the payload exposes for scripts.
ccx: Status bar appends 'ctx N%' after the first turn only (absent on a fresh session). Colour thresholds are built in: unstyled below 50%, `warning` token at >=50%, `error` token at >=80%, and at >=80% it additionally appends the literal ' ⚠ auto-compact soon'. ccx also has a `usageWarn` slot rendered in the error colour and a '⚙ N bg' background-task counter, neither of which has a claude footer counterpart.

title: Session-identity chrome in the welcome box: claude names the model and the auth provider, ccx names the model as '(default)'

claude: Welcome box header '╭─── Claude Code v2.1.222 ───╮' carries the version. Left column: 'Welcome back!', the ASCII logo, then 'Sonnet 5 · Claude API' (model display name · auth provider) and the resolved cwd. Right column: a 'Tips for getting started' block and a 'What's new' block listing three changelog lines truncated with '…', closed by '/release-notes for more'.
